entry.title: Naolly CREST Cue Tip
entry.summary:
Vendor: Cues Master Shop
Type:
Price: 1800.00

The Naolly CREST Cue Tip is a premium Japanese-made cue tip crafted from carefully selected black pigskin leather. Its advanced 10-layer laminated construction is engineered to deliver a refined balance of flexibility, elasticity, resilience, and grip, giving players a consistent and controlled connection with the cue ball.

Each leather layer undergoes a core-dyeing process to promote more uniform characteristics throughout the material, while Naolly's proprietary bonding technology helps maintain the integrity and stability of the laminated structure. The result is a cue tip designed for dependable response, precise cue ball control, and consistent feedback from shot to shot.

Features

  • Premium Japanese black pigskin leather
  • Advanced 10-layer laminated construction
  • Core-dyed leather for more uniform characteristics
  • Proprietary bonding technology between leather layers
  • Excellent chalk adhesion and cue ball grip
  • Controlled spin with responsive feedback
  • Balanced flexibility, elasticity, and resilience
  • Stable and consistent impact response
  • Approximately 14mm diameter
  • Approximately 6.6–7mm thickness
  • Available in Soft (S), Medium (M), and Hard (H)

Hardness Options

CREST S — Soft
Designed for players who prefer enhanced touch, sensitivity, and spin.

CREST M — Medium
A balanced option offering an excellent combination of control, feel, and power.

CREST H — Hard
Provides a firmer, more direct hit with crisp feedback and efficient energy transfer.

Perfect For

Players looking for a premium cue tip that combines precise control, excellent grip, responsive feedback, and consistent performance in a carefully engineered 10-layer Japanese pigskin construction.

10 layers. Refined response. Consistent control. The Naolly CREST is engineered for players who demand precision from every shot. 🎱

The Taom Fusion Cue Tip is engineered for players who want a powerful, precise, and responsive hit without sacrificing touch and control. Its unique hybrid construction combines a hardened center with softer, more elastic edges, creating a balanced response that delivers efficient power transfer while maintaining excellent feel around the cue ball.

Constructed from 7 layers of high-quality pigskin leather, the Fusion is designed to provide consistent energy transfer and a controlled, confident response across a wide range of shots. The firmer center supports powerful cue-ball action, while the softer outer edges help deliver the touch and control needed for precise positional play.

Features

  • 7-layer premium pigskin leather construction
  • Hardened center for efficient power transmission
  • Softer, more elastic edges for enhanced control and feel
  • Balanced combination of power, precision, and responsiveness
  • Designed for consistent performance across different shot types
  • 14mm diameter for pool cues
  • Advanced hybrid construction by Taom
  • Firm, controlled playing response

Perfect For

Players looking for a premium cue tip that combines power and control in one design. The Taom Fusion delivers a confident, responsive hit—from delicate positional shots to powerful cue-ball actions.

Power when you need it. Touch when it matters. The Taom Fusion delivers both. 🎱
